t: Titan 150mm medium orbital sander backing pad is a replacement support pad designed to restore worn hook and loop surfaces on random orbital sanders. Ideal for carpenters and decorators preparing timber or drywall surfaces, the pad improves disc retention to prevent slipping during intense sanding tasks. Constructed from durable ethylene-vinyl acetate foam and polypropylene, it offers a secure fit and reliable cushioning. The universal design allows for easy installation on most major sander brands, ensuring quick, efficient disc changes and consistent, even finishes on every job.
